ValidationRule.description: 仕様: Core 第11.4.2節。契約履歴のFrom。
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, "ContractHistory__c"), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "Opportunity"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "ContractHistory__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "Account"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "ContractService__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "BillingAccount__c") ) ) )
